title: euaraliopsis sumatrana
intro: Euaraliopsis sumatrana, commonly known as Sumatran dragon tree, is a plant species in the Aristolochiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and skin conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to inhibit platelet aggregation, exhibit antioxidant properties, and potentially reduce fever. Bioactive constituents of Euaraliopsis sumatrana include aristolochic acid, which has been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antiviral properties, although its use requires caution due to potential side effects.
